prior_year_events.impact_description: Reserve movements on the 2012 year of account resulted in an adverse run-off deviation recorded in 2015.

data.standardized_narrative: Syndicate 2088 had opening gross claims outstanding of GBP 75.697m at the start of 2015. During 2015 an adverse prior-year run-off deviation of GBP 0.4m was recorded, arising wholly from reserve movements on the 2012 year of account under the Whole Account Quota Share with Syndicate 2003. This represents a small net strengthening of prior year reserves (approximately 0.5% of opening gross claims outstanding).

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from Balance Sheet liabilities 'Claims outstanding' 2014 comparative column. Prior year movement sourced from note text (note 9) which explicitly states GBP 0.4m but uses contradictory wording 'adverse run-off deviation (prior accident year release)' - direction interpreted as adverse/strengthening. Claims development triangle (gross) is available and consistent; triangle units are thousands. No explicit named catastrophe events affecting prior years were identified beyond the 2012 quota-share reserve movement.
